label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The `busy` state is set to `false` only when the `exportReport` promise resolves successfully. If the export fails (e.g., due to a non-2xx response), the `catch` block is missing, leaving `busy` stuck as `true`. This explains why the button remains greyed out after a failed export. The fix should add error handling to reset `busy` to `false` in the `.catch()` block of the `exportReport` promise.

input.title: Re-enable the export button after a failed export
input.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The `handleClick` function in the `ExportButton` component only resets the `busy` state to `false` when the `exportReport` promise resolves successfully. If the export fails (e.g., due to a non-2xx HTTP response), the `busy` state remains `true`, disabling the button. To fix this, the `catch` block of the `exportReport` promise should also set `busy` to `false` to re-enable the button after a failure.
